name: codex-cr-loop
description: Codex review loop commands: iterate /codex:review until two consecutive clean rounds, with three completion modes (review-only stop, local merge, push + open PR). Always-on interaction-logic guard blocks user-visible UX changes (gestures, dialog/menu types, shortcuts, navigation) until the user explicitly confirms. Final report always ends with a Chinese business-impact summary module: a 3–8 line summary when commits change user-observable behavior, or a single literal line `无业务逻辑影响` for pure refactors. Preflight base-currency gate (v1.5.0) hard-stops the loop (rebase-first / abort) when the feature branch isn't built on top of its base; the base branch is auto-detected (main / master / any default). v1.6.0 adds CR_PR_AUTO_REBASE (default ON) to /cr-loop-pr: after convergence and before the push + PR, it re-fetches the PR base and, if that branch advanced while the loop ran, rebases the feature branch onto it and runs one confirmation review round before opening the PR (conflicts abort + defer; updating an existing PR after a rebase uses a user-confirmed --force-with-lease, never a bare --force). Set CR_PR_AUTO_REBASE=0 for the prior defer-and-handoff behavior.
